name: hxn
description: The Haxe classes of libraries built with hxn: futures, streams, signals, reactive values, atomics, and the macro that binds a packaged library.
releasenote: A threaded hxcpp web page gets a library's page files, so its browser agent runs as under Ash. A compile fails, naming both versions, when a package needs a newer hxn. hxn's hxcpp classes compile with hxcpp 4.3.2, a blocking method taking a data enum compiles, and hxn check fails an Ash web page whose program exits non-zero.
